spec.scope: Predeclared exploratory endpoints on unchanged 4621/8961 meshes. Nonlinearity is descriptive, with no threshold used to select a geometry or model.

scope: Finite exploratory ray endpoints, not approval of a larger training box, full stability or uniqueness. Linear deviation is ||s-D0 e||/||s|| with same-mesh D0. Plot lines are guides; only saved states and the analytic zero reference are shown. No learned models evaluated.
